COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRLR No. 187 of 2014
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Shri Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for the 
revisionist.
2. Shri B.P.S. Mer, learned Brief Holder for the 
State / respondent no. 1.
3. Shri Pawan Nath, learned counsel holding 
brief of Shri Prahant Khanna, learned counsel for 
the respondent nos. 3 and 4.
4. Steps were taken by the learned counsel for 
the revisionist for effecting service upon 
respondents no. 2 and 5, however, the office report 
indicates that notice could not be served upon 
them. 
5. Learned counsel for the revisionist submits 
that he will take fresh steps for effecting service 
upon respondent nos. 2 and 5 within a week. 
6. Let notices be served upon respondents no. 2 
and 5 through Chief Judicial Magistrate concerned. 
7. List this case along with other connected 
revisions on 30.06.2023. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 24.05.2023
SKS
